name: Barbecue Potato Chips
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 pound Russet potatoes, sliced thinly on a mandoline

steps: Add potatoes to hot oil one slice at a time, working in batches as needed. Fry potatoes for 4–5 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Once all potatoes have been fried, sprinkle liberally with the barbecue rub.
